title: Redis eviction caused authentication refresh failures
cause: a volatile-lru policy evicted refresh-token state during a campaign traffic spike
fix: reserved memory and changed the token cache to noeviction

title: Order events accumulated after consumer rebalance storm
cause: a Kubernetes rollout restarted every consumer in the group inside one session timeout
fix: set maxUnavailable to one and introduced a termination drain hook

title: Inventory reservations conflicted during replay
cause: replayed reservation messages used a non-stable operation key
fix: deployed 2.9.1 with deterministic reservation idempotency keys

title: Checkout failures after Payment Service 4.2 rollout
cause: 4.2 applied a fixed pool maximum of 40 per pod; with PostgreSQL 16 and 12 replicas this exhausted the 300-session database budget
fix: reduced maximumSize to 24 and minimumIdle to 6, then deployed 4.2.1

title: Payment authorization ambiguity during processor latency
cause: the provider response crossed the client deadline after authorization committed
fix: reconciled by idempotency key and disabled unsafe automatic retry

title: Catalog search returned stale prices
cause: an OpenSearch alias switch completed before the price enrichment consumer caught up
fix: gated alias promotion on consumer watermark

title: Gateway throttled trusted batch clients
cause: client identity normalization dropped the tenant partition from rate-limit keys
fix: restored tenant-aware keys and replayed rejected batches

title: Order confirmation delayed by Kafka lag
cause: a schema-registry timeout triggered repeated consumer restarts rather than the earlier rollout rebalance pattern
fix: pinned the cached schema and raised registry circuit-breaker tolerance

title: Notification provider backpressure
cause: provider quotas were shared across transactional and campaign traffic
fix: split quota pools and prioritized transactional topics

title: Customer merge deadlocks
cause: two merge workers locked customer identities in opposite order
fix: ordered locks by canonical customer ID and serialized duplicate merge keys
